repaired.name: Scenario
repaired.script:
fired := false
if (fired == true) {
wait until(all(#HumiditySensor).humiditySensor_humidity >= 50)
fired = false
}
wait until(all(#HumiditySensor).humiditySensor_humidity < 50)
all(#Dehumidifier).dehumidifier_setDehumidifierMode("drying")
fired = true

diagnosis.summary: The IR implements a rising-edge wait (fire once when humidity drops below 50, then wait for it to rise again). The candidate uses a periodic `if` which only checks the condition at the start of every 1-second iteration. At t=100ms, the condition became true, but the candidate's `if` guard evaluated to false at t=0 (when humidity was 0) and never re-evaluated until t=1000ms, missing the rising edge at t=100ms.
diagnosis.change_summary: Replaced the periodic `if` guard with the standard rising-edge state machine: persist a `fired` flag, block until the condition is false (rearm), block until the condition is true (trigger), execute the body, and update the flag. This ensures the action fires exactly when the humidity rises from >=50 to <50.
